notes:
Customer summary: mid-market e-commerce (direct-to-consumer) focused on post-purchase support — mostly returns, shipping status, refund ETA. Evaluating Hosted API now (fast time-to-value) with intention to move to Dedicated for seasonality/guarantees if POC meets latency SLOs.

Key requirements / quotes:
- "p95 latency needs to be <= 350ms for streaming responses during normal traffic; must stay under 600ms during peak bursts" — Head of Product (R. Ortiz).
- Need tool calling to do order lookup / initiate RMAs / surface shipping carrier status (webhook + API integrations).
- Streaming important: want progressive tokens for agent UI, not batch full response at end.
- Peak seasonality: expects 3x-4x traffic during peak returns windows (post-holiday, Black Friday promo returns).
- Cost sensitive but prioritizes reliability during peaks; open to committed Dedicated capacity for peak months.

Security / compliance notes:
- Requires SSO (SAML) and audit logging. SOC2 required — completed questionnaire in progress. KMS for key management requested. No hard data residency requirement today but may require EU region for EU customers.

POC specifics:
- 2-week POC on Hosted API: simulate peak traffic (3x baseline) + sustained burst tests. Measure p95 and error rates.
- Focus metrics: p95 latency (streaming), token cost per convo, success rate for tool calls, fallbacks to human agents latency > SLA.
- SE (Liam) recommended: prefix KV caching for order lookups, 1s max batching window, and adaptive batching thresholds; monitor cold-starts for model loading.

Commercial / next steps:
- Deliver Dedicated sizing + committed pricing for holiday window (Nov-Dec) by 2026-03-10.
short_description: Mid-market e-commerce evaluating Hosted API POC for chat/agent post-purchase support; will consider Dedicated for peak season guarantees. Focus: streaming, tool-calling, strict p95 latency + peak traffic handling.
